heading: How it works
desc: A visual canvas connected to your codebase.

steps.title: Wrap your dev server with a visual canvas.
steps.body: Airship brings your running app into a Figma-like visual workspace. Work directly with the real UI, explore layouts, and experiment across device sizes without rebuilding it in a separate design tool.

steps.title: Bring your coding agent into the canvas.
steps.body: Use Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode directly from Airship. Select an element, describe the change, and get the resulting code diff without switching between tools.
